definitions.explanation: The residence of the Emperor or other members of the imperial family. Most commonly refers to the Kyoto Imperial Palace ({京都御所|きょうとごしょ}), the former main residence of the Emperor before the capital moved to Tokyo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧{御所|ごしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I visited the Kyoto Imperial Palace.

examples.japanese: {御所|ごしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There is a lot of greenery around the imperial palace.

examples.japanese: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧⟦{天皇|てんのう}→天皇：04546_tennou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{住|す}まわれて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧{御所|ごしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一般|いっぱん}{公開|こうかい}→一般公開：16978_ippankoukai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The imperial palace where the Emperor once lived is now open to the public.

notes:
USAGE:
{御所|ごしょ} specifically refers to the Emperor's residence, while ⟦{皇居|こうきょ}→皇居：13607_koukyo⟧ is the modern term for the current imperial residence in Tokyo. ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧{御所|ごしょ} is the most common collocation, referring to the historic palace in Kyoto.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧{御所|ごしょ}: Kyoto Imperial Palace
- {仙洞|せんとう}{御所|ごしょ}: palace of a retired emperor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{皇居|こうきょ}→皇居：13607_koukyo⟧: Imperial Palace (current Tokyo residence)
- ⟦{宮殿|きゅうでん}→宮殿：12285_kyuuden⟧: palace (general term)
